correctness.rationale: For each integer n>=2, 0<r<1, finite H>=n or H=infinity, W=C D C^T with positive strictly ordered d_j. B=D^1/2 C^T C D^1/2 shares W spectrum, has diagonal d; Ky Fan gives all majorization inequalities. Equality of spectra and tr B^2 forces all orbit inner products zero. Hadamard yields determinant optimum and equality; a vector orthogonal to first n-1 orbit columns gives λmin bound and sharpness; dual columns give trace inverse bound and equality; Rayleigh gives λmax and condition number. Fourier diagonalization and positivity support prove full optimizer characterization. The self-contained Fraction checker tests 108 exact instances; this supplements but is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: One natural n-dimensional control-design problem is solved for every H>=n and H=infinity: exact and exclusive E-opt worst-case energy, D-opt reachability ellipsoid volume, A-opt average energy, and Gramian conditioning share the same explicitly computable Fourier-flat actuator class. The exact spectral majorization is stronger than four isolated inequalities; trace fails to distinguish a singular uniform actuator, while nonnegative optimal designs are precisely single-site controls. Worst-case control-energy formula has exponential dependence on cycle length for fixed damping. The result is not a parameter renaming or arbitrary finite numerical census.
